rows.status: CBC-SIZED for J5 (COORD 11-20: do not wait for the t13 / t15 scans); geometry from the plan face window, hop measured on t1 / t14; refine in J6 from the placed DBs
rows.evidence: The plan has no internal_stations on bus:coll_i0 on any serdes type. Measured (placed_hops_or.py at 300 um, wave b05c98f7919 3_place): serdes__t1__clb45db5be u_bin_coll_i0.q -> u_enc.d0 median 745 / max 817 um in one cycle (512 bits); serdes__t14 ring dch -> u_bin_coll_i0.q median 594 / max 749 um (GPL dragged the face flops inward); u_enc.d0 -> u_enc.p_d up to 984 / 914 um (encoder stretched between the face and the PMA); u_enc.p_d -> u_txl r0 median 496..559 max 755, r0 -> r1 max 760, last row -> q max 909 um: about 2300 um on the worst bit in 4 hops with 3 rows. Form: the encoder gets ONE anchor at (1500,860), under the middle of the PMA TX pin face, and the input bus walks there in registered hops: face S window centre (1074.4,0.0) -> anchor L1 1286 um = 5 hops of 257 um (cap 300) -> 4 stations, lane coll_i0 +4 clk. regs_um are straight-line aims: bit_sites_um by the station tool, clear of u_chn / u_dmem / u_cmem and the rate matcher (on the S-face types the line crosses the decoder macros, so the tool will dog-leg; if a dog-leg pushes a hop over 300 take one more station). With the encoder at the face centre the fan-out to the 2273 um pin face is 1268 um each way instead of 2018 one way.

rows.evidence: OT_S81_SERDES_TXL4 (DIE-S81-85 11-09, in main; TXL_N = TXL 2 + TXL4 2 + TXPIPE 1 = 5 relay rows of 545 bits, rows spaced by tools/die_plan/txl_mid.tcl, which the TXPIPE define already turns on at kit generation, face mode: last row at its PMA pin). Measured (placed_hops_or.py at 300 um, wave b05c98f7919 3_place): serdes__t1__clb45db5be u_bin_coll_i0.q -> u_enc.d0 median 745 / max 817 um in one cycle (512 bits); serdes__t14 ring dch -> u_bin_coll_i0.q median 594 / max 749 um (GPL dragged the face flops inward); u_enc.d0 -> u_enc.p_d up to 984 / 914 um (encoder stretched between the face and the PMA); u_enc.p_d -> u_txl r0 median 496..559 max 755, r0 -> r1 max 760, last row -> q max 909 um: about 2300 um on the worst bit in 4 hops with 3 rows. With the encoder anchored at (1500,860): worst bit 1268 + 233 = 1501 um in 6 hops = 250 um (cap 300). Without the anchor (encoder where GPL leaves it, x about 2250) 5 rows give 2300 / 6 = 383 um: under 405, over 300; 7 rows would need a new define. TX +2 clk on every beat; reset: none on the rows (LOCKSAFE holds >= 64 edges, as for the other rows). LATCHECK: +2 clk on the serdes TX lane.

With the encoder anchored at (1500,860): worst bit 1268 + 233 = 1501 um in 6 hops = 250 um (cap 300). Without the anchor (encoder where GPL leaves it, x about 2250) 5 rows give 2300 / 6 = 383 um: under 405, over 300; 7 rows would need a new define. TX +2 clk on every beat; reset: none on the rows (LOCKSAFE holds >= 64 edges, as for the other rows). LATCHECK: +2 clk on the serdes TX lane.

notes: 22 rows, 2 classes, all 11 serdes types. Not yet proven on a kit: the t15 proof kit from the first bind that carries them measures both classes (r712).
Cycles: lane coll_i0 +4 (t12, t13), +5 (t14, t3, t4), +6 (t15 x2, t1 x2, t16, t2); TX +2 on all.

Encoder internal stretch (d0 -> p_d up to 984 um) has no row: with both ends anchored (last coll_i0 station and u_txl row 0 one hop from the anchor) GPL has no pull apart; the proof kit shows whether a u_enc placement group is still needed.

RX / decoder legs over 300 um seen on the same wave DBs (u_syn x -> x_q 1018..1163, u_chn -> u_lpl w 563..619 median, u_lpr_syn.q -> u_lpl g_ck 544 median) are not in these rows: the wave kits lack AMPIPE / RM / coll_o0 stations; re-measure on R1 and the J4 kits first (J6).
